summary.intent: Get a status check on the callisto repo (git state, PRs, plans, Entire history), then move on to landing the unpushed v1 work (T01-T05/T11) as a clean commit stack.
summary.outcome: Produced a full status report: 0.10.0 shipped, v1 work local and unpushed, only dependabot #175 open. Agreed on a 5-layer crate-based commit stack and committed the four code layers by explicit path, leaving tool settings out. The docs/changesets layer and the push are not done.

repo: Callisto v1 plan is docs/projects/ROAD-TO-V1.md: 24 work units in 5 stages. Stage 1 is mostly moot since 0.9.0 and 0.10.0 shipped, and the baseline (8ef9aa5a4, 'awaiting merge') is stale.
Cargo.lock +368 lines (36 packages) comes from the new jsonschema = "0.53" dev-dependency in callisto-cli, used by the JSON-schema tests.
version.rs, release.rs, lib.rs, runner.rs, cascade.rs and CLI e2e test files contain hunks from several changesets, so a per-topic commit split needs hunk-level patch surgery.

The repo is public, and the user's memory notes say session transcripts must stay private. .entire/settings.json had push_sessions flipped to true and push_checkpoints enabled, so it must not be committed.
Entire tooling edits in .claude/settings.json (SubagentStop hook) and .gemini/settings.json (136 lines deleted) are not v1 work and were excluded from the stack.

V1-VERIFICATION.md records component-wise checks passing on Sep 28 (1,862 tests, Clippy, 93.45% coverage, 25 release-workflow suite cases). The aggregate `just ci` hit a sandbox lock in cargo-deny, so it was never green as a single run.

friction: Local commit T01 (20ce30cd1) may overlap with merged #170, which fixed the same verify step on main. This was not checked at the time of the report.
The dirty tree mixed 83 files of v1 work with unrelated Entire/Claude/Gemini settings edits, so everything had to be staged by explicit path.
Per-topic commits that each build are impractical because several files carry hunks from multiple changesets.
The aggregate `just ci` could not run cleanly due to a sandbox lock in cargo-deny.
Entire reports out-of-date Claude hooks and a legacy shadow branch, and has 174 checkpoints not yet on origin.
open_items: Commit layer 5 (changesets, specs, architecture docs, ROAD-TO-V1, README, V1-FINDINGS.md, V1-VERIFICATION.md, how-callisto-works.md).
Run cargo check after each layer and full `just ci` on the stack tip before any push.
Rebase onto current origin/main and resolve any overlap between T01 and #170.
Push as a native `gh stack` after user confirmation. Nothing has been pushed yet.
Merge dependabot PR #175 (taiki-e/install-action), which has all 11 checks passing.
Refresh ROAD-TO-V1.md baseline and Stage 1 status.
Start Stages 3-5: D01 owner-contract checkpoint, T06-T09 model changes, T10 generated workflows, T12 onboarding integration.

Clean up the Sep 27 stash, the stale origin branches (fix/native-resolution, fix/release-forge-lookup, fix/release-pr-verify-envelope, docs/spec-rewrite), and the Entire hooks and shadow branch (`entire enable --force`, `entire doctor`).
